summary: Hunter and tailor of Oberbirken; probably John's 6th-great-uncle.
bio: Jakob Heitzler was born in 1781 and died in 1847. A hunter and tailor by trade, he owned a house, number 36, in Oberbirken. He was probably John's 6th-great-uncle.
